name: support
title: Support
summary: Help cases and disputes: customer help and order-problem cases opened from the order with items pre-identified, seller support requests to Marketly, disputes between customer and seller with evidence, decision, remedy and appeal, plus categories, priority, owner, SLA deadlines, assignment, escalation and resolve/reopen rules.
owns: Cases (CS-YYMMDD-NNNN references) of four kinds: customer help, order problem, dispute, seller support request
Case categories with default priority, owning team and response/resolution targets (SLA)
Owner, team, assignment and bulk assignment; escalation to Returns, Finance, Trust and Risk or the Seller Manager
Who handles a case first (seller, Official Store, Marketly support), the next action, who must act and the expected response, shown to the customer
The formal case thread (customer, seller and staff messages with audience) and staff-only internal notes
Evidence from both parties, and the purchase terms and shipment evidence gathered for a dispute
Seller offers to the customer (ship by a date, refund, replacement) and the customer's answer
Decisions with outcome, remedies (refund, partial refund, replacement, return label, goodwill credit, ship-by deadline), reason shared with both parties and an appeal deadline
Appeals reviewed by a different staff member
Resolve and reopen rules: a case cannot be resolved while a promised refund or replacement is unresolved; reopen within a published window
notOwns: Help Center articles and policy pages: content
Informal private order conversations between customer and seller: messaging (support can join them)
Return requests, inspections and refund approvals: returns (a dispute remedy creates a refund request there)
Seller restriction appeals: sellers; review moderation appeals: reviews
Risk reports and enforcement: trust (support escalates to it)

stateMachines.name: Case
stateMachines.notes: Order problems about seller items start with sendToSeller (seller handles first, support follows). The job escalates automatically when the seller misses its reply deadline; a customer can escalate when they disagree, a promised refund is late, or the seller misses its deadline. escalate turns an order problem into a dispute (kind = dispute); an escalated case can be escalated again to another team (escalated → escalated: team, owner and deadlines change, the customer cannot ask twice). resolve is refused with REMEDY_PENDING while any remedy is pending_approval, approved or in_progress (plan ch. 17: do not close while a promised refund or replacement is unresolved). close runs automatically autoCloseAfterDays after resolve. reopen is allowed within reopenWindowDays of resolution. appeal is allowed until appealDeadline; decideAppeal must be done by a different staff member than the original decider and makes the decision final.

stateMachines.name: Remedy
stateMachines.notes: Refund remedies mirror the returns refund request and payments: approve on returns.refund.approved, start on handover, complete on payments.refund.sent, fail on payments.refund.failed, cancel on returns.refund.declined (the case goes back to the owner's queue). Goodwill credit remedies follow the wallet grant (case_remedies.goodwill_grant_id; wallet.goodwill.decided is matched on its grantId). Replacement remedies complete on delivery of the replacement shipment; a replacement cancelled before it ships (returns.replacement.cancelled) cancels its remedy and puts the case back in the owner's queue to choose another remedy. Ship-by-deadline remedies complete on shipping.shipment.dispatched when the items ship by the date and otherwise fall back to a refund. settle (and cancel from in_progress) is a staff action (POST …/remedies/{remedyId}/settle) for remedies nothing in the system can finish: refunds recorded for Finance while returns is off, goodwill or refunds of guests without a refund path; it is refused (REMEDY_NOT_SETTLEABLE) while a returns refund request, a wallet grant or a replacement still drives the remedy.

stateMachines.name: Case offer
stateMachines.notes: An accepted refund or replacement offer becomes a remedy on the case.

stateMachines.name: Appeal
stateMachines.notes: Reviewer must differ from the original decider (SAME_DECIDER).

endpoints.desc: Refund remedies create a refund request in returns (Finance approves within limits; approved is not sent). Goodwill credit needs the wallet module (GOODWILL_UNAVAILABLE while it is off, decision D-RT3); goodwill above the decider's limit needs approval through wallet and access. A guest has no wallet: their goodwill becomes a platform-funded partial refund through returns. Remedies left without items (goodwill, refunds) default to the case's items. A replacement is created by returns (returns.requestReplacement): it attaches to the case's open return when that return covers the item, otherwise it is a replacement without a return; REPLACEMENT_NEEDS_RETURN while the returns module is off. notifyParties=false still records and shows the decision but sends no email (notified=false). Platform-funded remedies above the decider's limit: the decision is saved pending (cases.approval_request_id) and the call answers 200 with AdminCaseDetail.pendingApproval; nothing is published until access.approval.decided. APPROVAL_REQUIRED (409, nothing saved) only while an earlier decision on the case still waits for approval.
endpoints.approval: Approval action support.remedies.approve. Platform-funded remedies above the decider's limit (e.g. $50) are saved pending and go to Finance through access (200 with pendingApproval); goodwill credit is checked by wallet.goodwill.grant

endpoints.desc: Overturning cancels the earlier decision's refund requests that can still be cancelled and records the new remedies. New platform-funded remedies above the reviewer's limit are saved pending (200 with AdminCaseDetail.pendingApproval) and published on access.approval.decided; APPROVAL_REQUIRED only while an earlier decision still waits for approval.

consumes.name: returns.refund.declined
consumes.does: Cancel the refund remedy behind the declined refund request (Finance's reason in the case history) and put the case back in the owner's queue so they decide again

consumes.name: payments.refund.sent
consumes.does: Complete the refund remedy; the case can now be resolved

consumes.name: wallet.goodwill.decided
consumes.does: For a case's goodwill credit remedy waiting for approval (matched on case_remedies.goodwill_grant_id = grantId): mark it granted (done) or rejected and put the case back in the owner's queue

consumes.name: payments.refund.failed
consumes.does: Mark the refund remedy failed and put the case back in the owner's queue

consumes.name: returns.replacement.created
consumes.does: Link the replacement to its remedy

consumes.name: returns.replacement.cancelled
consumes.does: A replacement cancelled before it shipped (no stock, seller or staff), with or without a return: cancel the remedy it drives (reason in the case history) and put the case back in the owner's queue to choose another remedy

consumes.name: shipping.shipment.delivered
consumes.does: Complete replacement remedies when their shipment is delivered

consumes.name: shipping.shipment.dispatched
consumes.does: Complete ship-by-deadline remedies whose items shipped by the promised date (lines, shippedAt); a later dispatch leaves the remedy to fall back to a refund

consumes.name: shipping.dispatch.overdue
consumes.does: Add the overdue dispatch to open cases for the item and expose the customer escalation route

consumes.name: shipping.shipment.exception
consumes.does: Open a case for lost or damaged packages reported by the carrier or the system. Exceptions with source customer_report, or with a caseRef (opened from a case), are only noted on the existing case, never a new one

consumes.name: sellers.seller.restricted

DUPLICATE_CASE.meaning: The item already has an open case. details.caseId, details.ref.

REMEDY_PENDING.meaning: A promised refund or replacement is not finished. details.remedies.

APPEAL_WINDOW_CLOSED.meaning: The appeal deadline has passed. details.appealDeadline.

REOPEN_WINDOW_CLOSED.meaning: The reopen window has ended. details.reopenUntil.

SAME_DECIDER.meaning: An appeal must be decided by someone other than the original decider.

OFFER_EXPIRED.meaning: The offer expired or was withdrawn.

ESCALATION_NOT_AVAILABLE.meaning: The seller is still within its reply deadline. details.availableFrom.

GOODWILL_UNAVAILABLE.meaning: Goodwill credit needs the wallet module, which is off; choose a refund or partial refund instead.

REPLACEMENT_NEEDS_RETURN.meaning: A replacement needs the returns module, which creates and ships it (with the case's return or without one); it is off, so choose a refund instead.

REMEDY_NOT_SETTLEABLE.meaning: The remedy is still driven by a refund request, wallet grant or replacement, or is already finished. details.status.

notes: Every customer-facing case answers three questions: who handles it (handledBy), what happens next and who must act (nextAction), and when a response is expected (expectedResponse). The app renders help/case from one call.
Order problems open from the order page with the item already identified (problem-context + createCase with orderItemIds).

Disputes reuse the order-problem case: escalate sets kind = dispute and assigns a support owner. The decision cites the purchase terms snapshot from orders and the shipment evidence from shipping; both are composed at read time, not copied.
Remedies are tracked on the case and mirror returns and payments progress; Approved is never shown as money arrived. A case stays open until each promised remedy completes (REMEDY_PENDING).
Internal notes (audience internal) are never returned on store or seller endpoints.

Goodwill-credit remedies call wallet.grantGoodwill when the wallet module (phase 3) is on; while it is off they are refused with GOODWILL_UNAVAILABLE (decision D-RT3), so no remedy waits for a credit that cannot exist. Guests have no wallet: their goodwill becomes a platform-funded partial refund through returns of the case's items. Goodwill and refund remedies without items default to the case's items.

No remedy may stay pending for ever: without returns a refund remedy is recorded for Finance and closed with POST …/remedies/{remedyId}/settle once paid outside the system; declined refund requests cancel their remedy (returns.refund.declined); ship-by remedies complete on dispatch (shipping.shipment.dispatched).
Case actions are recorded in audit under category support (audit adds the category).
Email replies (notifications.email_reply.received, module support) join the thread like a reply from the customer.

Seller support requests (seller/help) are cases of kind seller_request handled by the Seller Manager team with their own categories (Account health, Fees and payouts, Listing rules, Shipping, Returns and disputes, Advertising).
Business-hour deadlines use the market time zone and business hours from settings (optional dependency; defaults Mon–Sat 8 AM–8 PM PT).

Dependency note: returns, payments, shipping, sellers, messaging and media are optional; without returns a refund remedy is recorded as a request to Finance outside the system and settled by staff (settleRemedy).

Case replacements: returns.requestReplacement attaches the replacement to the case's open return when that return covers the item (the return completes when it ships); otherwise it is a replacement without a return (caseId set, returnId null). Either way the remedy links on returns.replacement.created, completes on delivery and is cancelled on returns.replacement.cancelled.

Case facts live in columns of cases (order and return references, names, what the customer asked for, the open information request, the last escalation, the first seller reply, the dispatch warning, job markers); next_action keeps only the stored next action.

openCase with a returnId (return escalation) copies the return's evidence into the case at opening through returns.listEvidence, each item marked as from the return with its original author and time. Later additions on the return are not synced; the case is the record from then on. Without returns enabled no evidence is copied.
